div.div:
فِعَالٌ , as distinguished from فَعَالٌ, signifies A doing that is between two [agents]; (IAar, O, K, TA;) and therefore it is an inf. n. of ↓ فَاعَلَ [a verb of which I have not found any ex.]. (TA.) ―
-b2- It is also a pl. of فِعْلٌ. (S, O, Msb, K. ＝
-A2- Also The handle, (K,) or piece of wood that is inserted into the hole, (IAar, IB, O,) of the axe, or adz, or hoe: (IAar, IB, O, K:) pl. فُعُلٌ. (K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
